title: Game HUD Feedback Motion Study
summary: Motion study for hit feedback, cooldowns, damage direction, status effects, and controller clarity.
prompt: Create a motion study for a combat HUD in {argument name="game_title" default="Rune Reactor"}. Animate normal, hit, low health, status effect, cooldown ready, ammo low, objective update, and boss mechanic states. Include timing notes for hitstop, camera shake, sound layers, controller vibration, colorblind-safe alternatives, and subtitle-safe placement.
